diagnostic_kind: standalone versioned numerical representation of already derived Y-only action RHS; no H3/H4 solve

inputs.a: positive finite background scale factor a(t), one value per time row
inputs.Q: finite frozen background Q_action(t), same time grid as a
inputs.u10_phi10_dx: real first-order aether rapidity and comoving scalar spatial derivative arrays [nt,nx]
inputs.KB: frozen dimensionless KB from existing model
inputs.a0: frozen positive A0_MPC_INV in same units as Q and kfund, no fresh unit conversion
inputs.beta: one of preregistered 1.0, 0.5, 0.1, no outcome-based selection
inputs.kfund: fixed positive comoving fundamental Fourier wave number
inputs.grid: periodic real-space pseudo-spectral; same time and spatial array shape for all inputs

exact_frozen_equations.source_sign: These expressions are RHS sources in original L Z=-E convention, not Euler residuals

frozen_numerical_representation.method: real-space |g|g, then Fourier transform once, then 2/3 flux projection, then the same projected flux for aether and spectral scalar derivative
frozen_numerical_representation.fft_normalization: numpy fft/ifft internal normalization; no extra 1/nx for real-space reconstruction
frozen_numerical_representation.two_thirds_mask: abs(FFTFREQ(nx)*nx) <= nx/3 + 1e-12, including Nyquist handling by same rule as frozen Repair07 mask23
frozen_numerical_representation.retained_modes: no new m cut beyond this standard flux mask; downstream existing m<=40 projection remains separate
frozen_numerical_representation.derivative: multiply 1j*kfund*mode on filtered flux then inverse FFT; return real physical fields

implementation_tests.all_inputs_shape_finite_and_positive: reject mismatched [nt,nx], nonfinite a,Q,fields, or nonpositive a/a0/kfund
implementation_tests.row_order_and_zero_rows: six main rows and two constraint rows; only u and phi may be nonzero
implementation_tests.source_sign_and_volume: match exact Stage D H3/H4 formulas with a^3 at every time node
implementation_tests.zero_set: g10 identically zero => H4 source exactly zero for any finite g11
implementation_tests.eta_tangent: H4 equals symmetric eta finite difference of standalone H3 source at preregistered eps=1e-5 to relative L2 <= 1e-4, with absolute tolerance 1e-8 of test field scale
implementation_tests.aether_scalar_flux: same projected flux gives exact discrete relation before scalar divergence
implementation_tests.H3_vs_frozen_scalar: for m below 2/3 cutoff, new scalar H3 = a**3 times the existing frozen reduced H3 Y source, within 1e-12 relative L2 on deterministic fields
implementation_tests.H4_vs_frozen_scalar: for m below 2/3 cutoff, new scalar H4 = a**3 times the frozen Repair37 DY2 scalar contribution, within 1e-12 relative L2 on deterministic fields
implementation_tests.action_directional: independently check representative +/- branch action derivatives in Stage D; no empirical parameter fitting
implementation_tests.test_provenance: JSON with exact source blobs, deterministic fields and all gate outcomes; dedicated CI and optional lightweight local runner

outcomes.Y_SOURCE_ROW_DICTIONARY_IMPLEMENTATION_P: All source gates pass; freeze standalone versioned Y-only source module and test results, then preregister corrected H3 parent reclosure and appropriate dependent parent controls.
outcomes.Y_SOURCE_ROW_IMPLEMENTATION_FAIL: Any exact input/row/zero-set/tangent/legacy-scalar comparator gate fails; preserve failure and version fixes separately.
